ana: Quick note from the onboarding sampleapp run: client window went over limit when token rotated mid-pagination. Repro locally with small harness.

rory: Any minimal logs?

ana: paste:
```
INFO page=8 inflight=5 state=waiting-auth status=401
INFO auth refresh start tok=tmp-11
INFO auth refresh done tok=tmp-12
INFO replay page=8 inflight=6 duplicate send -> upstream 429
```
Shows retry increments inflight without releasing original permit.

jas: Parity check: py-sdk has release-on-terminal-state so retries don't double-count. JS currently re-acquires inside auth wrapper which causes overshoot.

iren: Short-term hack: auth wrapper can call window.release() before refresh and re-acquire after, but that risks another caller grabbing the permit. Not ideal but quick.

jas: Better: use a lease or logical-id pattern so a single logical request maps to one slot even across retries. Sketch:
```js
const lease = await window.acquire(); // opaque lease id
try {
  await sendWithAuth(req, {leaseId: lease.id}); // retries reuse leaseId
} finally {
  await window.release(lease.id);
}
```
This keeps accounting stable and works for background prefetch too.

ana: I'll add a tiny integration test in the sampleapp that forces mid-batch 401s and asserts inflight <= windowSize. If test reproduces deterministically, we can patch the JS SDK.

iren: Also good to add a short blurb in quickstart explaining lease vs naive counters to reduce support noise.

devex-bot: Created ticket RDW-9999: "onboard sampleapp: window overshoot on auth replay; propose lease/logical-id" and linked branch r/fix/lease-window. Assigned jas (impl), ana (test), iren (docs). :thumbsup:
